gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-yantramanav: Loud stencil punch, with wide bridges slicing through every Snowburst One letter. And Yantramanav, a modern sans with huddled letters and lowercase nearly reaching the capitals, gives that noise somewhere quiet to land.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-outfit: Cut-stencil punch from Snowburst One, bridges wide and loud. Outfit's rounded sans-serif curves never swell or thin, and its lowercase sits lower than the heading's, so the two feel like a shout and a murmur.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-display: Tube-bent bravado: Tilt Neon draws every stroke at a constant width, with a splayed c terminal adding swagger. Noto Sans Display keeps its sans-serif lowercase generous and approachable.
